thesis.thesis: HISTORICAL PRELIMINARY RESEARCH NOTE — NOT A LIVE INVESTMENT RECOMMENDATION. NVIDIA Corporation [nvda-2024-08-28-q2-fy2025] passed a frozen, offline, disclosure-only screen using exactly two criteria: reported GAAP gross margin >= 40% and reported revenue year-over-year >= 0%. For the quarter ended 2024-07-28 (filing date 2024-08-28), reported GAAP revenue was USD 30,040 million with revenue YoY of +122%, and GAAP gross margin was 75.1%. Both criteria were met with wide margin. This is a single-company historical candidate-research pass on one filing; it is not a ranking, not a comparison against other issuers on a common date, and not evidence of attractiveness. The screen deliberately excluded share price, valuation, analyst targets, and forward returns, so no conclusion about price or expected return can be drawn from it.
